question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**consistently**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"consistently"** means happening in the same way over time, showing reliability or uniformity. (सतत या निरंतर)

 
 
• **Example:** He has consistently scored high marks in every examination.
 
 
 
• In the context of the passage, "consistently" fits because it reflects how the speaker regularly dissatisfies themselves.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**consistently**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unpredictability** (अप्रत्याशितता): The state of being unable to predict or foresee something.

 
 
• **Example:** The unpredictability of the weather in the mountains makes hiking challenging.
 
 
 
• **Conflictingly** (विरोधाभासी रूप से): In a manner that involves conflict or opposition.
 
 
• **Example:** The witnesses described the incident conflictingly, making it hard to understand what actually happened.
 
 
 
• **Clumsily** (अनाड़ीपन से): In an awkward or unskillful manner.
 
 
• **Example:** He clumsily dropped the vase, shattering it into pieces.
